claim: On Amazon.com KDP charges a flat $2.30 to print a black-ink paperback of 24 to 110 pages, so a 6x9 book at $9.99 keeps $3.69 a copy at 24 pages and at 110; at 112 pages printing is $2.34 and it keeps $3.65.
notes: Real-time capture of the live free calculator at 360x640 CSS px, 3x device pixels. The grey ring marks each tap. KDP's help page: 'Black-ink paperbacks with 24 - 110 pages only incur the fixed cost' of 2.30 USD (24-108 pages on Amazon.com.au); 110-828 pages are 1.00 USD + 0.012 USD per page; 60% royalty at $9.99. The final 2.2 s hold the 112-page result still for the end card.
